summary.name: iTerm2
summary.one_liner: iTerm2 is a free, GPL v2-licensed terminal emulator for macOS that replaces the built-in Terminal app and succeeds the original iTerm.
use_cases: replace the default macOS Terminal app
work extensively in a command line shell on a Mac
report bugs or request features for a terminal app
find documentation and FAQ for a Mac terminal
summary.what_it_does: The page describes iTerm2 as a replacement for the macOS Terminal app and the successor to iTerm. It is aimed at people who spend a lot of time in a terminal and says it adds many small features that improve that work. The page links to a features list, screenshots, an FAQ, documentation, a bug tracker, a forum, and the source code on GitHub. It does not list specific features in the text provided.
notable: Successor to the original iTerm terminal
Support via bug tracker, forum, FAQ and documentation
